error = function(e) normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
"Could not locate inputs/scripts/setup_publication.R from the Rmd location or working directory.",
# Keep knitted previews at the same physical width as the exported infographic.
# Set TRUE only when you want the QA audit printed in the knitted HTML.
# UNIFORM INFOGRAPHIC PAGE CONTRACT — ALL SIX CHAPTERS
# Publication pages are fixed-size. Every NONFINAL page must contain:
# Final continuation pages may contain fewer rows, but they use the exact same
# physical canvas, typography, column widths, row height, and export DPI.
# If a future edit creates a sixth section header inside the first 30 rows,
# pagination stops with an error rather than silently shrinking the page.
"Infographic data must contain a `Section` column for fixed pagination.",
"Infographic `Section` contains NA values; page-header counts would be ambiguous.",
# The six current chapter infographics are intentionally structured so every
# full/nonfinal page has the exact same 30 + 5 composition.
# Deliberately split by BODY rows first. We do not silently reduce the body-row
# count to compensate for too many headings. Instead, the page contract above
# requires the chapter's visible section structure to fit the common 30 + 5
"`rows_per_page` must equal the publication standard of ",
"`section_headers_per_page` must equal the publication standard of ",
". Keep full pages at exactly 30 body rows + 5 visible section headers; ",
"do not shrink typography or the canvas.",
# Override the helper's exporter inside this Rmd so every chapter is guaranteed
# to use the same body-row rule, section-header rule, continuation treatment,
# The infographic may draw from BOTH:
#   1. source files used by the current figures.Rmd, and
#   2. source files used by the current tables.Rmd.
# This prevents old/retired source IDs from silently re-entering the report
# while preserving table-derived statistics that belong in the chapter
"`", id, "` is not referenced by the current figures.Rmd or tables.Rmd. ",
"Update CURRENT_REPORT_SOURCES only after the report source files change.",
stop("`", id, "` is not a current figure source.", call. = FALSE)
stop("`", id, "` is not a current table source.", call. = FALSE)

# Keep the section header responsible for the repeated concept ("international",

"Where international students come from" = "Countries of origin",

.data$Measure == "Institutions citing feeling unwelcome in the united states" ~
